support_budget: K examples per target class globally; K in 1..10
client_features: row-normalize in float64 before per-class averaging
aggregation: sum(client_mean * client_count) / sum(client_count), float64 accumulation, float32 output
server_loss: count-weighted full-batch cross-entropy on scale-100 logits
server_optimizer: Adam; default betas/epsilon; weight_decay=0; foreach=false; fused=false
prior: normalize each of three mapped text views; average; row-normalize
zero_shot: K=0 uses W0 directly; no support or upload
scope: Frozen prototype numerical kernel with portable input preparation; historical setting-specific inputs are external
